text:
Max: Quick idea — introduce a stability-score adapter between policy-eval and selector to reduce flip-flops across latency/cost/region constraints.

Olivia: sounds promising. is it invasive?

Max: small adapter shim. selector API unchanged: it consumes candidate list + scores. Adapter fills scores and reasons.

Pranav: how to keep dedicated pools from being penalized?

Max: adapter will accept context: tenant_tier, dedicated_hint, region_pref. We'll give dedicated pools a boosted base_score.

Diane: we need time-based recovery for region affinity — cold GPU spinups currently cause repeated reroutes.

Max: propose exponential decay penalty: score *= exp(-delta / tau). default tau=300s, tenant-configurable.

Ashley: telem needed before canary: candidate_score histograms, decision_reason tag, fallback_count.

infra-bot: feature flag available: policy.adapters.enabled. Recommend IP-restricted canary + config gating.

Pranav: perf worry — per-request scoring CPU cost.

Max: add short cache (1s) for scores per-route + invalidation on capacity/latency signal. batch score for hedged requests.

Olivia: also need a sim run on recent traces to spot regressions.

Max: plan: implement adapter + built-in hysteresis; run 2w sim; shadow 5% for 1w; canary IPs 1w; ramp if green.

Diane: migration checklist?

Max: - create adapter interface (v2)
- implement default hysteresis adapter
- hookup telemetry + flags
- run sim + shadow canary
- monitor osc_rate and cost_delta thresholds

Pranav: metrics we should track: oscillation_rate (routes/sec flipping), median_latency, cost_delta.

Ashley: add decision_reason to traces for postmortem.

Olivia: docs + RFC next week?

Max: I'll author RFC with API shape and sim harness pointers, will drop to #architecture. :thumbsup:
